thread:
janet: Heads-up: need to finalize PRD section for KMS/HSM + audit log retention before roadmap sync. Customers pushed for CMEK and retention flexibility.
omar: From security: must support CMEK (customer-managed keys) and an HSM-backed option. Requirements: key rotation records, access control audit trails, and explicit export restrictions. Envelope encryption for caches is required.
liam: Implementation constraints: integrating CMEK with our vault is feasible; HSM integration adds complexity and latency. Cache entries should store key_id references only, not raw keys.
sophia: Auditor asks: we need written policies (rotation, access reviews), HSM attestation (FIPS/Module ID), retention matrix, and an exceptions process. Evidence artifacts must be exportable.
janet: Proposed launch gates: security sign-off, compliance evidence bundle, successful staging canary, and published runbooks + docs.
anya: Customers vary: some need 7-year logs, others 90 days. PRD should call out configurable retention per org and show cost delta.
omar: We can expose per-org retention within bounds. Security review needed for >1 year metadata retention. Also require immutable audit logs for configured window.
liam: Edge cases to capture: compromised key -> rewrap/rotate flow; cross-region key availability for DR; re-encryption should be async and rate-limited.
sophia: Acceptance criteria (draft): 1) CMEK available for Dedicated/Private; 2) HSM option validated in staging with attestation docs; 3) Audit logs record principal/action/resource/timestamp/request_id and are tamper-evident; 4) Retention settings enforceable and demonstrable; 5) Runbook for key compromise tested via tabletop.
janet: Rollout defaults: self-serve keeps Redwood-managed keys; CMEK is opt-in for Dedicated/Private; HSM is billed as an enterprise add-on.
anya: Prioritization: enterprise deals requiring CMEK + long retention = high-priority for Dedicated roadmap. Include in risk matrix.
omar: Compliance detail: logs must be hashed/chained and include sufficient context for forensic review. Provide export format for auditors.
liam: Perf data: HSM ops add ~8-15ms in our microbench—need full-load benchmarks. For now, gate HSM to high-tier customers.
sophia: For SOC2/ISO evidence: provide sample retention report, raw audit export, KMS access history, rotation logs, and access review artifacts. Also define deletion policy and constraints.
janet: Owners: liam -> engineering runbooks + rewrap design; omar -> security playbooks + config flags; sophia -> auditor evidence pack; anya -> priority and sales gating.
liam: I'll draft an appendix with rewrap pseudo-code, async migration plan, and perf test plan by Wednesday.
omar: I'll produce HSM attestation checklist and required KMS config options.
sophia: I'll assemble the compliance artifact checklist and sample reports. Tabletop scheduled.
anya: I'll update PRD priority, customer asks, and cost implications.
deploy-bot: janet uploaded /docs/prd/cmek-hsm-audit-retention-draft.md :white_check_mark:
janet: Thanks. Target to circulate PRD draft for review by Thursday EOD so roadmap can be locked Monday.
liam: Will open PR with architecture diagram and rewrap flow tomorrow.
omar: Add acceptance tests: simulated key rotation + audit export validation in staging. Make these CI gated for deploy.
sophia: Tabletop for key compromise response Thursday 3pm. Invite sent.
janet: Great. Next steps captured; will follow up with reviewers. :memo:
